title: Storefront & theme
desc: A shop that looks like your brand without touching a stylesheet. Every choice below is a setting in the admin, saved as a draft until you publish it.

specs.title: 28 themes to start from
specs.desc: Nineteen light and nine dark, each a complete look rather than a colour swap. Pick one and adjust anything.

specs.title: Dark mode
specs.desc: Always light, always dark, or follow the visitor's own device setting.

specs.title: Page width
specs.desc: Narrow, default, wide, or edge-to-edge full width.

specs.title: Spacing and type scale
specs.desc: Section rhythm and base text size as settings — the proportions that actually make two stores look different, not just the colours.

specs.title: Three hero layouts
specs.desc: Centred, split with the image beside the text, or a wide banner.

specs.title: Your own CSS

specs.title: Four header styles
specs.desc: Default, centred, minimal or search-forward. Sticky or static.

specs.title: Two footer styles
specs.desc: Centred, or multi-column with your own link groups.

specs.title: Your fonts
specs.desc: Separate body and heading typefaces, set per store.

specs.title: Card style and ratio
specs.desc: Product card treatment, image aspect ratio and grid density.

specs.title: Corner radius & button shape
specs.desc: Sharp, soft or pill, applied consistently across the store.

specs.title: Product gallery style
specs.desc: Choose how images behave on the product page.

specs.title: Announcement bar
specs.desc: One line above the header for a sale, a cut-off date or a shipping notice.

specs.title: Logo & favicon
specs.desc: Uploaded in the admin, no file access needed.

specs.title: Social links
specs.desc: Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube in the footer.

specs.title: Draft → publish → restore
specs.desc: Theme edits sit in a draft. Publish when ready, discard a bad idea, or restore the last published version.

specs.title: Nested navigation menus
specs.desc: Multi-level menus you reorder yourself, for header and footer.

specs.title: 404 and search pages
specs.desc: Handled, styled and included — not an afterthought.

title: Page builder

specs.title: Hero
specs.desc: Full-width banner with heading, copy and call to action.

specs.title: Slider
specs.desc: Rotating banners for campaigns and seasonal pushes.

specs.title: Product grid
specs.desc: Hand-picked products or a whole category.

specs.title: Category tiles
specs.desc: Visual entry points into your catalog — hand-pick the categories or let it shuffle.

specs.title: Hand-picked products
specs.desc: Choose exact products for a section rather than a whole category.

specs.title: Trust badges
specs.desc: Returns, delivery and payment reassurance, worded per section rather than fixed site-wide.

specs.title: Customer reviews block
specs.desc: Real reviews from the catalog, placed on any page.

specs.title: Shoppable video carousel
specs.desc: A row of videos that link straight to the product.

specs.title: Grid or carousel
specs.desc: Product sections render as a grid or a swipeable carousel.

specs.title: Image + text
specs.desc: Alternating story blocks for brand and craft copy.

specs.title: Testimonials
specs.desc: Customer quotes with attribution.

specs.title: Countdown
specs.desc: Live timer for a sale or a drop.

specs.title: Video
specs.desc: Embedded product or brand video.

specs.title: FAQ
specs.desc: Expandable question list, good for objection handling.

specs.title: Rich text
specs.desc: Long-form copy where you need it.

specs.title: Newsletter
specs.desc: Email capture placed anywhere on the page.

specs.title: Drag to reorder
specs.desc: Section order changes by dragging, with per-section draft status.

specs.title: Image uploads
specs.desc: Straight into a section from the editor.

specs.title: Unlimited pages
specs.desc: Any slug you like — about, care guide, size chart, shipping policy.

title: Catalog & inventory
desc: Built for real catalogs: variants that actually differ in price and weight, stock you can trust, and the tax fields Indian invoicing needs.

specs.title: Bulk import from Excelshipping soon
specs.desc: Fill in the template, upload one file, and the whole catalog lands at once.

specs.title: Nested categories
specs.desc: Parent and child categories, each with its own image and SEO fields.

specs.title: Attribute master
specs.desc: Define Size, Colour and anything else once, reuse across products.

specs.title: Generated variants
specs.desc: Combinations built from attributes, each with its own SKU.

specs.title: Per-variant pricing
specs.desc: Price and compare-at price, so struck-through MRP is per variant.

specs.title: Per-variant weight
specs.desc: Grams per variant, which is what shipping rates are actually calculated from.

specs.title: Stock tracking
specs.desc: On-hand counts with a low-stock threshold per variant.

specs.title: Backorder control
specs.desc: Allow or block sales past zero, per variant.

specs.title: Multiple images
specs.desc: Reorder by dragging, set the primary, write alt text on each.

specs.title: Custom product sections
specs.desc: Extra titled content blocks on a product page — care instructions, sizing, materials.

specs.title: HSN codes
specs.desc: Stored per product, ready for GST-compliant invoicing.

specs.title: Per-product SEO
specs.desc: Meta title and description overrides on every product and category.

title: Product reviews
desc: Reviews collected on your own store, not rented from a review app charging monthly.

specs.title: Star ratings & written reviews
specs.desc: Title, body and rating from the customer.

specs.title: Verified purchase badge
specs.desc: Reviews tied to a real order are marked as such.

specs.title: Moderation queue
specs.desc: Nothing appears until you approve it.

specs.title: No monthly fee
specs.desc: It is part of the platform, not a subscription bolted onto it.

title: Cart & checkout
desc: The place most Indian stores leak money. Serviceability, COD rules and coupons are all handled before the customer reaches the payment screen.

specs.title: Mini-cart drawer
specs.desc: Slides over the page instead of interrupting browsing.

specs.title: Pincode serviceability
specs.desc: Customers check delivery before they commit — fewer undeliverable orders.

specs.title: Pincode → city/state
specs.desc: Looked up and cached, so the address form fills itself.

specs.title: COD with rules
specs.desc: Enable it, charge a COD fee, and set minimum and maximum order values for it.

specs.title: Phone verification
specs.desc: One-time code before a COD order is accepted, with attempt limits and expiry.

specs.title: Coupon codes
specs.desc: Percentage or fixed, minimum subtotal, redemption cap and expiry date.

specs.title: Conditional coupon rules
specs.desc: Five conditions — cart total, item count, a specific product, a category, or an item in a price band — combined with all-must-match or any-can-match.

specs.title: Discount the cart or just the items
specs.desc: Apply the discount to the whole cart, or only to the lines that actually matched the rule.

specs.title: Free shipping as a coupon
specs.desc: A code can waive shipping instead of taking money off.

specs.title: Discount ceiling
specs.desc: Cap what a percentage coupon can ever give away.

specs.title: Free shipping threshold
specs.desc: Set the order value above which shipping is free.

specs.title: Tax handling
specs.desc: Configurable rate applied and broken out on the order.

specs.title: Cart restore links
specs.desc: A link that rebuilds a customer's exact cart on any device.

specs.title: Price snapshots
specs.desc: Line items store the name and price at the time of the order, so history stays truthful when you re-price.

specs.title: Full money breakdown
specs.desc: Subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total stored separately on every order.

specs.title: UTM stored per order
specs.desc: The campaign that produced each order is on the order record itself.

title: Payments
desc: Four gateways, connected to your own account. Money settles directly to your bank — we are never in the payment path.

specs.title: Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe or PayU
specs.desc: Pick the one you already have an account with. Cards, UPI, net banking and wallets through whichever you choose.

specs.title: Run more than one
specs.desc: Configure several and the customer picks at checkout. Switch provider without rebuilding anything.

specs.title: Half-configured is never offered
specs.desc: A gateway missing a credential cannot be selected or shown, so it can never take a live order. With none configured, checkout offers COD only.

specs.title: Signature-verified webhooks
specs.desc: Payment confirmations are cryptographically checked before they are trusted, per gateway, and fail closed when no secret is set.

specs.title: Confirmed by webhook, not the browser
specs.desc: A customer who closes the tab straight after paying still gets their order.

specs.title: Automatic reconciliation
specs.desc: Payment IDs matched back to the order, so a paid order cannot go quietly missing.

specs.title: Manual payment marking
specs.desc: Record an offline or bank-transfer payment against an order.

specs.title: Prepaid and COD side by side
specs.desc: Both flows in one order pipeline.

title: Shipping & fulfilment
desc: Rate it, then actually ship it. Shiprocket is driven from the order screen — nobody has to keep a courier portal open in another tab.

specs.title: Shipping zones
specs.desc: Multiple zones with priority ordering when they overlap.

specs.title: Pincode ranges per zone
specs.desc: Assign zones by pincode range rather than one at a time.

specs.title: Rate methods
specs.desc: Flat rate or free-over-amount, multiple methods per zone.

specs.title: Weight-based rating
specs.desc: Calculated from real per-variant weights, not a guess.

specs.title: Shipping markup
specs.desc: Add a percentage on courier rates if you don't pass them through at cost.

specs.title: Shiprocket shipments
specs.desc: Create the shipment from the order, manually or automatically.

specs.title: AWB assignment
specs.desc: Pick the courier and get the tracking number without leaving the admin.

specs.title: Labels & manifests
specs.desc: Generated and stored against the shipment.

specs.title: Pickup scheduling
specs.desc: Book the pickup from the same screen.

specs.title: Tracking webhooks
specs.desc: Status updates arrive automatically as the parcel moves.

specs.title: Cancellation
specs.desc: Cancel a shipment when an order falls through.

specs.title: Default package dimensions
specs.desc: Set once so every shipment doesn't need measuring.

specs.title: RTO rate
specs.desc: How much of what you ship comes back, measured rather than guessed.

specs.title: Stuck shipment detection
specs.desc: Parcels that have not moved in a window you set, surfaced before the customer asks.

title: WhatsApp & Instagram
desc: One inbox for both channels, next to the order the customer is asking about. This is the module most brands otherwise rent for thousands a month.

specs.title: Unified inbox
specs.desc: WhatsApp and Instagram threads in one WhatsApp-Web style two-pane view.

specs.title: WhatsApp Cloud API
specs.desc: Your own Meta account and number, not a shared gateway.

specs.title: Template sync
specs.desc: Approved templates pulled from Meta with their variables detected.

specs.title: Send templates
specs.desc: Fire an approved template to a customer from the admin.

specs.title: Business profile
specs.desc: Edit your WhatsApp business profile from the settings screen.

specs.title: Instagram DMs
specs.desc: Direct messages handled in the same inbox.

specs.title: Auto-DM commenters
specs.desc: Reply privately to people who comment on a post, automatically.

specs.title: Public comment replies
specs.desc: Optionally post a public reply under the comment too.

specs.title: Signed webhooks
specs.desc: Inbound messages are HMAC-verified, so nothing spoofed enters your inbox.

specs.title: Read state
specs.desc: Threads track what has been seen and what is still waiting.

title: Customers & identity
desc: The same person browsing anonymously, ordering by phone and messaging on Instagram is one record, not three.

specs.title: Identity graph
specs.desc: Sessions, orders and conversations stitched into a single person.

specs.title: Multiple identifiers
specs.desc: Email, phone, WhatsApp ID and Instagram ID all resolve to the same customer.

specs.title: Full customer view
specs.desc: Everything they browsed, bought and asked about on one screen.

specs.title: Order history
specs.desc: Per customer, with the money breakdown intact.

specs.title: Contact capture at checkout
specs.desc: Name, phone and email recorded on the cart before payment, so an abandoned cart is still reachable.

specs.title: Audience segments
specs.desc: Nine rules — bought a product, bought from a category, lifetime spend, order count, never bought, ordered or didn't order within N days, abandoned recently, delivery state — combined into a reusable audience.

title: Abandoned cart recovery
desc: Carts go stale on a timer you set, then get chased on a channel you choose — with variants, so you find out what actually works.

specs.title: Automatic detection
specs.desc: Carts marked abandoned after a window you configure.

specs.title: Message variants
specs.desc: Multiple versions of the nudge, so you can compare them rather than guess.

specs.title: WhatsApp or email
specs.desc: Per variant, using your approved template or your own copy.

specs.title: Send caps
specs.desc: A hard limit on how many times one cart is chased.

specs.title: Recovery tracking
specs.desc: Sessions record whether a cart was recovered and which order it became.

specs.title: One-click cart restore
specs.desc: The link in the message rebuilds the exact cart.

title: Broadcast campaigns
desc: One-off WhatsApp sends to a segment you define, with delivery tracked per recipient rather than reported as a single hopeful total.

specs.title: Audience targeting
specs.desc: Send to a segment built from the nine customer rules, not to everyone you have a number for.

specs.title: Audience preview
specs.desc: See who a segment resolves to, and how many, before anything sends.

specs.title: Schedule or send now
specs.desc: Draft, schedule, send, pause and cancel — a campaign can be stopped mid-flight.

specs.title: Per-recipient retry
specs.desc: WhatsApp fails individual messages constantly. A failed recipient is retried with backoff up to five attempts; the rest of the batch is never re-sent because one number bounced.

specs.title: Delivery breakdown
specs.desc: Queued, sent, delivered, read and failed, counted separately.

specs.title: Batched sending
specs.desc: Work is queued and paced rather than fired in one burst.

title: Journeys & automation
desc: Multi-step flows triggered by real behaviour — a welcome sequence, a post-purchase follow-up, a win-back — built visually and run by a scheduler.

specs.title: Visual flow builder
specs.desc: Build the whole sequence as an ordered list of steps.

specs.title: Five behaviour triggers
specs.desc: Welcome, cart abandoned, browse abandoned, order placed and order shipped — enrolment happens on the event, not on a list upload.

specs.title: Wait steps
specs.desc: Hold for hours or days between messages.

specs.title: Filter steps
specs.desc: Branch or drop out based on what the customer has since done.

specs.title: Message steps
specs.desc: Send on the channel you've configured.

specs.title: Duplicate protection
specs.desc: A customer cannot be enrolled twice into the same active flow.

specs.title: Draft and live states
specs.desc: Build a journey without it running, then switch it on.

specs.title: Manual enrolment
specs.desc: Push a specific customer into a flow when you want to.

title: Analytics & attribution
desc: First-party session data on your own server, plus properly de-duplicated conversion events going out to the ad platforms.

specs.title: Live visitor view
specs.desc: Who is on the site right now, and what they are looking at.

specs.title: Session journeys
specs.desc: Replay the path a visitor took — pages, products, cart value, exit.

specs.title: UTM capture
specs.desc: Source, medium, campaign, term and content recorded per session and carried to the order.

specs.title: Referrer & landing page
specs.desc: Where each session came from and where it entered.

specs.title: Device detection
specs.desc: Split behaviour by device without a third-party script.

specs.title: Conversion linkage
specs.desc: Sessions record which order they converted into and when.

specs.title: GA4
specs.desc: Measurement ID configured in settings.

specs.title: On-site search terms
specs.desc: What shoppers typed into your search box, how often, and how many results each returned.

specs.title: Zero-result searches
specs.desc: Demand you are not meeting yet, in your customers' own words.

title: Meta Pixel & Conversions API
desc: Under-reported conversions make Meta optimise against you, and your cost per acquisition climbs for reasons no dashboard explains. Every event is sent twice — once from the browser, once from your server — and de-duplicated, so blockers and iOS cannot quietly hide your results.

specs.title: Six standard events
specs.desc: PageView, ViewContent, Search, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout and Purchase, fired from the storefront.

specs.title: Browser + server, every time
specs.desc: The Pixel fires in the browser and your server sends its own copy of the same event to the Conversions API.

specs.title: Shared event ID de-duplication
specs.desc: Both copies carry the same event ID, so Meta merges them and one purchase counts once, not twice.

specs.title: Payload matched on both sides
specs.desc: Content IDs, content type, item count and value are identical in the browser and server events — mismatched payloads are the usual reason de-duplication silently fails.

specs.title: Queued, never inline
specs.desc: Sending runs as a background job, so a slow response from Meta can never delay a customer's checkout.

specs.title: Automatic retries
specs.desc: Three attempts, then the event is parked for a human to look at rather than dropped.

specs.title: Idempotent sends
specs.desc: An event already delivered is skipped on retry, so a requeue cannot inflate your numbers.

specs.title: SHA-256 hashed identifiers
specs.desc: Email and phone are hashed before transmission. The plain values never leave your server.

specs.title: Click and browser cookies forwarded
specs.desc: fbp and fbc are passed through, which is what lifts Meta's match quality score.

specs.title: IP and user agent forwarded
specs.desc: Further match-quality signals, sent server-side where a blocker cannot strip them.

specs.title: Consent enforced twice
specs.desc: Checked when the event is captured and again at the moment of transmission — defence in depth, not a single flag.

specs.title: Test event code
specs.desc: Verify events are landing in Events Manager before you spend a rupee on traffic.

specs.title: Per-event delivery status
specs.desc: Every event records whether it was sent, skipped or failed, with Meta's own error message kept for diagnosis.

specs.title: Purchases linked to orders
specs.desc: A Purchase event carries the order it came from, so reported revenue can be reconciled against your own database.

title: Ad spend & ROAS
desc: Return calculated against orders the store actually took, rather than what a platform claims it drove.

specs.title: Spend logging
specs.desc: Record spend by date, source and campaign.

specs.title: ROAS by campaign
specs.desc: Return measured against real orders in your own database.

specs.title: Source breakdown
specs.desc: Compare channels on the same basis.

specs.title: Ties to order UTMs
specs.desc: Because campaign data is stored on the order, not inferred later.

title: AI & the store connector
desc: Two separate things, worth keeping separate. AI that drafts content inside the admin, and a connector that lets Claude or ChatGPT read your store directly and answer questions from real data. The connector runs on the Claude or ChatGPT subscription you already pay for — no API key, nothing billed per token; an API key is the second path, for work that runs unattended. Neither can publish anything you have not approved. How the safety model works →

specs.title: Connector costs nothing per query
specs.desc: It runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription. The store spends no tokens — it hands over data and stores what the model wrote. No API key involved.

specs.title: An API key only for unattended work
specs.desc: The WhatsApp concierge and bulk generation run on the server, so those need a key. Everything else can be done through the connector for free.

specs.title: Your provider, your key
specs.desc: Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama on your own machine. Billed to your account, at cost, with no markup from us.

specs.title: Nothing publishes without you
specs.desc: Generation writes to a review queue. Applying a draft is the only path that touches live content, and it runs in a transaction.

specs.title: A column allowlist, not a polite request
specs.desc: Generated text can only ever land in columns named in the code — name, description, SEO meta and alt text. A model that invents a price or an order status changes nothing.

specs.title: Daily spend cap in rupees
specs.desc: Checked before every call, so a runaway loop cannot run up a bill.

specs.title: Cost recorded per task
specs.desc: Tokens in, tokens out and the rupee cost stored against every generation.

specs.title: Product copy and SEO meta
specs.desc: Titles, descriptions and meta drafted from the product you already have.

specs.title: Alt text written from the photograph
specs.desc: The model is shown the actual image and describes what is in it, rather than paraphrasing the filename.

specs.title: Campaign and journey copy
specs.desc: Broadcast and automation-step messages drafted into the same review queue, within WhatsApp's length limits.

specs.title: FAQ and section copy
specs.desc: Hero headlines, trust wording and question-and-answer blocks for the page builder.

specs.title: Written in your voice
specs.desc: Your existing published copy is used as the style reference, so drafts sound like your brand rather than like a model.

specs.title: AI shopping concierge
specs.desc: Answers WhatsApp and Instagram messages from your live catalog. It may only recommend products actually retrieved from your catalog, so it cannot invent a product, a price or a stock level.

specs.title: Connect Claude or ChatGPT
specs.desc: 50 tools spanning sales, orders, customers, catalog, shipping, campaigns and SEO. Ask in plain language and get answers from your own data.

specs.title: Read-only until you say otherwise
specs.desc: The seven tools that change anything are off until an admin switches writes on, separately from the connector itself.

specs.title: Your staff roles apply to the AI
specs.desc: Every tool checks the same permission as the admin screen showing the same data — nothing new to grant, and nothing reachable that the person could not already open.

specs.title: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE
specs.desc: Claude and ChatGPT register themselves over the remote MCP standard. Tokens and client secrets are stored hashed, never in the clear.

specs.title: Connector writes are audited
specs.desc: Anything it changes leaves the same activity trail an admin action would, marked as having come from the connector.

specs.title: One set of numbers
specs.desc: Connector tools read through the same reporting code as the Reports screen, so the two cannot quote different revenue for the same week.

specs.title: Entirely optional
specs.desc: Configure no key and every AI feature simply sits dormant. The store runs exactly as it otherwise would.

specs.title: Themes over the connector
specs.desc: Ask Claude or ChatGPT what the store looks like now, list the presets, draft a change for review, or publish one.

title: SEO
desc: The unglamorous parts that decide whether Google sends you anything.

specs.title: Automatic sitemap.xml
specs.desc: Regenerated as your catalog changes.

specs.title: Editable robots.txt
specs.desc: Managed from settings, not by editing a file over FTP.

specs.title: Clean URLs
specs.desc: Readable slugs for products, categories and pages.

specs.title: Automatic 301 redirects
specs.desc: Rename a slug and the old URL redirects itself, so you keep the rankings you earned.

specs.title: Per-entity meta
specs.desc: Title, description, robots directive and OG image per product, category and page.

specs.title: Default OG image
specs.desc: A brand fallback for anything without its own.

specs.title: Structured storefront markup
specs.desc: Product data marked up for search engines.

specs.title: SEO audit
specs.desc: Measured coverage of meta titles, descriptions, body copy and alt text across the catalog. A check that cannot be verified reports unknown rather than guessing a pass.

specs.title: Search-result preview
specs.desc: See how a title and description will look in Google before you save them.

specs.title: Internal link gaps
specs.desc: Products and pages that nothing on the site links to.

title: Security & abuse protection
desc: The question every self-hosted buyer asks second. Public endpoints are gated, webhooks are cryptographically verified, and nothing that accepts input from a stranger is left uncapped.

specs.title: Signature-verified payments
specs.desc: Razorpay webhooks are checked against your secret before a payment is believed. A forged callback cannot mark an order paid.

specs.title: HMAC-verified Meta webhooks
specs.desc: WhatsApp and Instagram payloads verified with SHA-256 and a timing-safe comparison, so nothing spoofed reaches your inbox.

specs.title: Verified webhook handshakes
specs.desc: Meta's subscribe challenge is answered with a timing-safe token check, not a string match.

specs.title: Per-IP rate limiting
specs.desc: Fixed-window caps shared across cart, reviews and tracking, with automatic cleanup so the counter table can't grow unbounded.

specs.title: Review flood protection
specs.desc: A hard per-minute cap per IP on review submission.

specs.title: Beacon caps
specs.desc: The analytics endpoint is capped per window, so nobody can inflate your session data.

specs.title: Same-origin beacon guard
specs.desc: Tracking posts from another site are rejected outright.

specs.title: Hashed OTP codes
specs.desc: Verification codes are stored hashed, never in plain text — a database dump does not hand over live codes.

specs.title: Attempt lockout
specs.desc: Repeated wrong codes close the verification instead of allowing a brute force.

specs.title: Proxy-aware client IP
specs.desc: Honours Cloudflare's connecting-IP header, behind a trust setting so the header cannot be spoofed when you are not behind a proxy.

specs.title: Hashed staff passwords
specs.desc: Admin credentials stored with PHP's password hashing, not reversible encryption.

specs.title: Capability-gated admin
specs.desc: Every admin action checks a capability, so an account cannot reach a screen it was not granted.

title: Admin & platform
desc: The things that make it survivable in production, and yours at the end of it.

specs.title: Role-based access
specs.desc: Staff accounts with capabilities, so a packer cannot open your settings.

specs.title: Account state
specs.desc: Deactivate a user without deleting their history. Last-login recorded.

specs.title: Background job runner
specs.desc: Slow work queued and retried instead of blocking a page load.

specs.title: Integration tests
specs.desc: A test button per integration that verifies credentials before you trust them.

specs.title: Newsletter subscribers
specs.desc: Captured from storefront sections, stored with their source.

specs.title: Activity logging
specs.desc: A record of what changed in the admin.

specs.title: Ordinary PHP 8 & MySQL
specs.desc: No exotic runtime. Any competent developer can read, host and extend it.

specs.title: Source code at handover
specs.desc: Yours, with the database and every credential.
